items.question: Do I need previous grooming experience?
items.answer: No. The Level 2 City & Guilds course is designed for complete beginners. Our refresher courses are intended for people who already have some grooming knowledge or professional experience.

items.question: Will I work with real dogs?
items.answer: Yes. Practical experience is a central part of the training. Students work with dogs of different breeds, sizes, coat types and temperaments under appropriate supervision.

items.question: Is City & Guilds recognised?
items.answer: Yes. City & Guilds is a nationally recognised awarding organisation. The qualification provides a structured foundation for people who want to begin working within professional dog grooming.

items.question: Can I start my own business after the course?
items.answer: The course can give you the practical foundation and qualification needed to begin your journey, but starting a business also requires planning, suitable insurance, equipment, pricing and continued development. Liza shares practical industry knowledge throughout the training to help you understand what is involved.

items.question: Which course is right for me?
items.answer: That depends on your current experience and what you want to achieve. Contact the Academy and tell us a little about your background and goals. We will help you identify the most suitable starting point.

items.question: How do I enquire about a course?
items.answer: Use the course enquiry button or contact The Pet Studio directly. We will explain availability, course structure and the next steps before you make a decision.
